name: Adaptive Atomic ReduCtion Hardware (ARC-HW)
definition: A hardware-software implementation of ARC using a low-overhead hardware module in SMs to perform warp-level reduction using registers and leveraging the address coalescing unit. It dynamically schedules atomic computations between SM and ROP units based on utilization. Exposed via a new ISA instruction.
summary: ARC-HW is a hardware-software cooperative primitive that accelerates commutative atomic additions in differentiable rendering by performing warp-level reduction within the Streaming Multiprocessor and dynamically distributing remaining atomic computation between the SM and L2 ROP units.
